|game1= arma3

|descr= Returns [[Arma 3: CfgWorlds Config Reference#class OutsideTerrain|OutsideTerrain]]'s current world's values.

|gr1= Diagnostic

|s1= [[diag_dumpTerrainSynth]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Number]], [[Array]] of [[Number]]s: [analysisLength, [min1, max1], [min2, max2], ..., [min512, max512]]. There are 512 min/max pairs.

* min1..512: [[Number]] - minimum altitude
* max1..512: [[Number]] - maximum altitude
